decisions.reason: Two-component resin injection builds directly on the firm's plural-component pumping and dosing know-how, so it can interpret early results and refine the unit in-house.
A second resin injection unit draws on the same core plural-component knowledge, though overlap with Product A slightly raises the risk of consolidation.
Automatic airless spray guns sit at the heart of the firm's established spray application expertise and manufacturing, giving strong absorptive capacity to improve them.
Manual airless guns are a core accessory line closely tied to existing pumps and customers, so the firm can easily learn from field feedback and sustain the product.
An air-assisted airless gun line extends existing spray technology with several models, and it fits the firm's knowledge base and its customers in industrial coating.

A data logger moves into digital and electronic knowledge further from the firm's mechanical core, which makes it harder to assimilate, but it complements coating equipment and supports service, so the firm keeps it while learning.
